description: GitLab Community Edition: private Git repositories, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, container registry and wiki, fully self-hosted. Replaces GitHub, Bitbucket and Jenkins. On Fluxcaler VPS it is also the Git home of your AI employees: their skills, agents and project repositories.
